Bupropion is the active ingredient in Wellbutrin and Zyban, Auvelity contains bupropion and dextromethorphan, and Contrave contains bupropion and naltrexone. Bupropion improves mood regulation and nicotine cravings and, when combined with naltrexone, helps reduce food intake.
Bupropion is thought to work by changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain, including noradrenaline and dopamine.
Bupropion first became an FDA-approved medicine on 30 December 1985.
